title: 2024 review: turned an indifferent business into a partner
summary: My manager rated three goals Exceeds and called my Ultrasound partnership the home run of the year, a relationship built in the face of indifference and turned into trust.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a role or recognition event, not an intervention.
the_call: Listen to each business before proposing a solution.
what_i_did: Held 104 connects with 389 colleagues, re-engaged business leaders who asked for repeat sessions, and worked with HR to raise the hiring bar.
what_changed: Three goals rated Exceeds; 28 pieces of feedback from the Software Excellence team and almost every business unit.

quotes.text: You created a relationship in the face of indifference towards SWE from the BU and turned it into a trusted relationship.
quotes.role: Manager, head of worldwide Software Excellence

quotes.text: There is feedback that you listen deeply and don't try to force a pre-canned solution onto the BU, but you understand what they really need.
quotes.role: Manager, head of worldwide Software Excellence
